resolvedFindings: Dispose/load and queued replacement races preserve ownership and expose cleanup failure
Exact contiguous shots reject tiny accepted gaps
Native skin palettes forced current for repeated absolute seeks inside one render ID
Bound authored prop scale respects root multiplier and normalized child units
Studio waits for validated host-ready handshake before one queued load
Malformed stored registrations isolated while overlay-dependent references revalidate on load
Cancelled game load returns failure instead of a successful protocol reply
limits: No browser automation, screenshot/physical pixels, real audio device playback, GPU timing/residency, device FPS or proven active cap20/60FPS. NullEngine verifies logic, native CPU draw submissions and resource ownership only.
Actual shipped skin/morph/clip/geometry sources are retained; source images use opaque1x1fixtures. Whole rendered visual equivalence remains unmeasured.
Real main camera/context callbacks are AST-extracted with injected surrounding globals; this is targeted production-branch execution, not full browser startup.
Built inventory is read-only against root-produced artifacts; compressed sizes are local perfile recompression, not measured host transfer or browser startup performance.
Verifier did not run full suite/build/deploy/commit, generate assets, call paid providers or modify actual default map/cinematic aesthetics. Root owns release validation.
